CHAP_FV101.name: CHAP_FV101
CHAP_FV101.label: LT FV101 Scorpion
CHAP_FV101.description: The FV101 Scorpion is a British light tank that was introduced in the 1970s. It is part of the Combat Vehicle Reconnaissance (Tracked) family and is known for its speed and agility. The Scorpion is armed with a 76mm gun and a coaxial machine gun, making it effective against both infantry and light armored vehicles. It has a crew of three: commander, gunner, and driver. The vehicle's lightweight design allows it to be air-transportable, making it suitable for rapid deployment in various combat scenarios.

CHAP_T90M.name: CHAP_T90M
CHAP_T90M.label: MBT T-90M
CHAP_T90M.description: The T-90M is a modernized version of the T-90 main battle tank, which is a third-generation Russian tank. The T-90M features several upgrades over its predecessor, including improved armor protection, enhanced firepower, and advanced electronics. It is equipped with a 125mm smoothbore gun capable of firing a variety of ammunition types, including anti-tank guided missiles. The tank also has an upgraded engine and suspension system, providing better mobility on the battlefield. The T-90M is designed to operate in various combat environments and is used by several countries around the world.

CHAP_PantsirS1.name: CHAP_PantsirS1
CHAP_PantsirS1.label: SA-22 Pantsir-S1 "Greyhound"
CHAP_PantsirS1.description: The Pantsir-S1 is a Russian self-propelled anti-aircraft weapon system designed to provide short to medium-range air defense against a variety of aerial threats, including aircraft, helicopters, drones, and precision-guided munitions. The system combines surface-to-air missiles and anti-aircraft artillery in a single platform, allowing it to engage multiple targets simultaneously. The Pantsir-S1 is equipped with advanced radar and electro-optical tracking systems, enabling it to detect and track targets in various weather conditions. It is typically mounted on a wheeled or tracked chassis, providing mobility and rapid deployment capabilities.

CHAP_T84OplotM.name: CHAP_T84OplotM
CHAP_T84OplotM.label: MBT T-84 Oplot-M
CHAP_T84OplotM.description: The T-84 Oplot-M is a Ukrainian main battle tank that represents an advanced version of the T-80 series. It features significant upgrades in armor protection, firepower, and mobility. The tank is equipped with a 125mm smoothbore gun capable of firing a variety of ammunition types, including anti-tank guided missiles. The Oplot-M also boasts enhanced composite and reactive armor, providing improved survivability against modern anti-tank threats. Additionally, the tank is powered by a high-performance diesel engine, allowing for greater operational range and speed on the battlefield. The T-84 Oplot-M is designed to meet the demands of modern armored warfare and is used by the Ukrainian armed forces.

CHAP_T64BV.name: CHAP_T64BV
CHAP_T64BV.label: MBT T-64BV Type 2017
CHAP_T64BV.description: The T-64BV is an upgraded version of the T-64 main battle tank, which was originally developed by the Soviet Union. The T-64BV features enhanced armor protection, improved firepower, and advanced electronics compared to its predecessor. It is equipped with a 125mm smoothbore gun capable of firing a variety of ammunition types, including anti-tank guided missiles. The tank also has an upgraded engine and suspension system, providing better mobility on the battlefield. The T-64BV is designed to operate in various combat environments and has been used by several countries, including Ukraine and Russia.

CHAP_TorM2.name: CHAP_TorM2
CHAP_TorM2.label: SA-15 Tor M2 "Gauntlet"
CHAP_TorM2.description: The Tor M2 is a Russian self-propelled anti-aircraft missile system designed to provide short-range air defense against a variety of aerial threats, including aircraft, helicopters, drones, and precision-guided munitions. The system is mounted on a tracked chassis, providing mobility and the ability to operate in various terrains. The Tor M2 is equipped with advanced radar and electro-optical tracking systems, allowing it to detect and engage multiple targets simultaneously. It uses 9M331 missiles, which are highly maneuverable and capable of intercepting fast-moving targets. The Tor M2 is widely used by the Russian military and has been exported to several other countries.
